# Rever

> Rever turns a website URL into a detailed, ready-to-paste prompt for recreating that site's UI with an AI code generator (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, Cursor). It screenshots the page and has a vision model describe the layout, sections, components, colors, typography and spacing as build instructions. Use it when a user asks to clone, copy, rebuild or get inspired by an existing website's design.

No account needed. AI agents pay $0.25 per request in USDC on Base with the standard x402 protocol: any x402 client (e.g. `@x402/fetch`, Coinbase AgentKit) pays automatically. People buy a pack of generations by card on the website.

## What you get

- Input: one public `http(s)` URL.
- Output: JSON `{ "prompt": "...", "url": "..." }`, a plain-text design brief (not code). Feed it to a code model to generate React + Tailwind.
- Typical latency: 10–30 s.
- Limits: renders what a normal browser sees after load (top 1280×3200 px); pages behind logins or heavy bot protection may fail. You are only charged when a prompt is returned.

## API

- Endpoint: `POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt` with body `{"url": "https://example.com"}`
- [OpenAPI spec](https://www.aypiai.online/openapi.json)
- [Full agent guide](https://www.aypiai.online/llms-full.txt): payment options, errors, examples

## Payment (x402)

1. Call the endpoint without payment → HTTP 402 with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402 v2): scheme `exact`, network `eip155:8453` (Base), asset USDC, amount `250000` ($0.25).
2. Your x402 client signs a USDC authorization (gasless for you) and retries with the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.
3. You get the prompt, plus a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header with the settlement receipt.

Other ways to pay: send 0.25 USDC on Base to the `payTo` address and retry with `X-Payment: <transaction hash>`, or use a pack key in `X-Access-Key`.

## Tools

- Remote MCP server: `https://www.aypiai.online/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, tool `clone_ui`), listed in the official MCP Registry as `online.aypiai.www/rever`
- [Local MCP server](https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner/tree/main/rever-mcp): same tool over stdio
- [MCP server card](https://www.aypiai.online/.well-known/mcp.json)

## Optional

- [Web app](https://www.aypiai.online/): paste a URL, buy packs by card (10 generations for 9,99 €)
- [Showcase](https://www.aypiai.online/showcase): directory of ~10,000 sites built with Vercel and Lovable ([JSON](https://www.aypiai.online/showcase.json))
- [Source code](https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner)
